import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import sqlite3
from scipy import stats

# Load the data again
conn = sqlite3.connect('salesforce.db')
df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM salesforce_data", conn)
conn.close()

# Identify column types
numeric_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
categorical_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['object']).columns.tolist()
date_cols = df.select_dtypes(include=['datetime64']).columns.tolist()

print(f"Numeric columns: {numeric_cols}")
print(f"Categorical columns: {categorical_cols}")
print(f"Date columns: {date_cols}")

# Exclude confidential fields (assuming 'id' might be confidential)
non_confidential_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col != 'id']
df_analysis = df[non_confidential_cols]

# Create aggregated records by department and account_industry
agg_df = df_analysis.groupby(['department', 'account_industry']).agg({
    'revenue': ['mean', 'std', 'count'],
    'employees': ['mean', 'std']
}).round(2)

# Flatten multi-level columns
agg_df.columns = ['_'.join(col).strip() for col in agg_df.columns.values]
agg_df = agg_df.reset_index()

# Calculate distinctiveness score using z-score for revenue_mean and employees_mean
for col in ['revenue_mean', 'employees_mean']:
    agg_df[f'{col}_zscore'] = np.abs(stats.zscore(agg_df[col].fillna(0)))

# Overall distinctiveness score (average of absolute z-scores)
agg_df['distinctiveness_score'] = agg_df[['revenue_mean_zscore', 'employees_mean_zscore']].mean(axis=1)

# Get top 10 most distinctive aggregated records
top_10_distinctive = agg_df.nlargest(10, 'distinctiveness_score')

print("\nTop 10 most distinctive aggregated records:")
print(top_10_distinctive.to_string(index=False))

# Supporting metrics summary
print("\nSupporting metrics for top 10 distinctive records:")
print(f"Average distinctiveness score: {top_10_distinctive['distinctiveness_score'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"Revenue range in top 10: ${top_10_distinctive['revenue_mean'].min():,.0f} to ${top_10_distinctive['revenue_mean'].max():,.0f}")
print(f"Employees range in top 10: {top_10_distinctive['employees_mean'].min():.0f} to {top_10_distinctive['employees_mean'].max():.0f}")
